title: 16-layer HfO2/Al2O3/SiO2 with QWOT initialization and 15nm thickness floor
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 14 to 16 while enforcing quarter-wave optical thickness initialization (lambda_0=267nm) with +/-8nm Gaussian noise and 15nm minimum thickness floor will improve passband transmission and stopband blocking by providing additional degrees of freedom while avoiding numerically unstable thin-film regimes.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack scaffold with bounded perturbation initialization prevents optimizer collapse into suboptimal local minima. Additional layers provide more interference control for dual stopband suppression.
proposed_topology: exactly 16 finite layers from the incident side: HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2
manufacturing_considerations: All materials are conventional depositable inorganic dielectrics
theory_basis: Quarter-wave optical thickness provides constructive interference at target wavelength
Additional layers increase stopband width and depth through more interference interfaces
expected_advantages: QWOT initialization guides optimizer toward physically meaningful solutions
known_risks: May still converge to local optima similar to 14-layer results
HfO2 absorption at deep UV may limit peak transmission
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 16-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 16-layer dielectric stack on fused silica substrate for solar-blind UV filtering. Material sequence: SiO2|HfO2|Al2O3|SiO2|HfO2|Al2O3|SiO2|HfO2|Al2O3|SiO2|HfO2|Al2O3|SiO2|HfO2|Al2O3|SiO2. Initialize all layer thicknesses to quarter-wave optical thickness at 267 nm center wavelength (thickness = 267/(4*n_material)) with bounded Gaussian noise +/-8 nm. Enforce minimum thickness floor of 15 nm for all layers. Optimize thicknesses within 15-200 nm bounds using gradient-based optimizer. Evaluate at normal incidence. Maximize transmittance in 255-280 nm band, minimize transmittance in 300-700 nm and 700-1100 nm bands. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 255–280 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Transmittance in 300–700 nm; Transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers; No metal layers; Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Increased layer count from 14 to 16 to provide additional interference control. Applied QWOT initialization with +/-8nm noise and 15nm thickness floor per feedback directives to address score regression from 0.5453 to 0.3696.
